subject.title: Discover live model inventory + data-driven picker matching (robust to new models)

question: Should browser mode intentionally accept an explicit raw model name that appears in ChatGPT’s live picker when that name is absent from Oracle’s maintained model catalog?
rationale: The inventory implementation changes the supported browser-mode model contract, not only its DOM matching: values such as `o3` would begin working even though CLI inference does not recognize them.

options.title: Allow browser-only live models
options.body: Keep the curated API catalog, but permit explicit browser `-m` values to resolve against the discovered picker inventory with the legacy selector retained as fallback.

options.title: Keep catalog-only selection
options.body: Use inventory discovery to find known Oracle aliases but reject names outside the maintained catalog.

options.title: Pause the feature direction
options.body: Hold this PR until the permanent browser-model contract is explicitly decided.

recommendation.title: Allow browser-only live models
recommendation.body: Keep the curated API catalog, but permit explicit browser `-m` values to resolve against the discovered picker inventory with the legacy selector retained as fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership and release history make steipete the best available decision owner for Oracle’s browser model-selection contract.
